result.summary: The street features a well-marked zebra crosswalk with curb ramps and tactile paving, set within a high-density mixed-use environment. However, visibility for pedestrians is compromised by vehicles parked close to the crossing, and there are no visible traffic control signals or signs to prioritize pedestrian movement.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: A white van is parked very close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks stop signs or signals, relying entirely on driver compliance in a busy urban area.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of people in the crosswalk.
